transcript.speaker: Ms. Clark
transcript.text: Good evening! Welcome to Westfield High. Can I help you?

transcript.speaker: Mr. Harris
transcript.text: Yes, I'm Mr. Harris. We're choosing a school for my son. How do you educate your students?

transcript.speaker: Ms. Clark
transcript.text: We use small classes and plenty of discussion. Every student studies the required subjects first.

transcript.speaker: Mr. Harris
transcript.text: How do you give grades? Do you have many exams?

transcript.speaker: Ms. Clark
transcript.text: We use continuous assessment. A student's grade comes from their work all year. They write two assignments every month.

transcript.speaker: Mr. Harris
transcript.text: What about phones? Do you allow them in class?

transcript.speaker: Ms. Clark
transcript.text: We allow phones at break time. We ban them during lessons.

transcript.speaker: Mr. Harris
transcript.text: My son had problems with bullying at his old school. How do you handle that?

transcript.speaker: Ms. Clark
transcript.text: We take bullying seriously. Students report it to us. We talk to everyone. We expect good behavior from all students.

transcript.speaker: Mr. Harris
transcript.text: Does every student do work experience?

transcript.speaker: Ms. Clark
transcript.text: Yes, in the final year. They spend three weeks in a real workplace.

transcript.speaker: Mr. Harris
transcript.text: That sounds good. When does the school year start?

transcript.speaker: Ms. Clark
transcript.text: In September. Bring your son to visit us. We'd love to meet him.
